title: DomainEvent Envelope
description: Standard envelope wrapping every domain event in the HIMS platform. All fields are required.

iq_tenant_id.description: Tenant scope — every event is tenant-scoped

occurred_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the domain event occurred

published_at.description: Optional transport-layer publish time; reserved for future broker integrations.

correlation_id.description: Propagated from the originating request for distributed tracing

actor_id.description: User or service account that triggered the action

event_contract_version.description: Semver of the event contract. Consumers can route on this.

payload.description: Event-specific data. Schema defined per event_type in the module's events spec.
